text:
chris: FYI customer sent a final checklist: they need explicit maintenance-window policy + upgrade acceptance criteria before they sign.

maya: can you summarize the non-negotiables?

chris: main ones: 1) define maintenance window (max 2h weekly, timezone aligned), 2) guarantee <=2 rolling restarts for minor patches, 3) fallback relay available if BGP fails, 4) rollback MTTR targets and automated snapshot rollback, 5) preflight pass required for initial rollout.

devon: maintenance window: customers expect local-netops to pick the hour. we should support timezone-aware scheduling and an API to query upcoming windows.

frank: for MTTR let's propose: fast lane <=20m, cautious <=90m. fast lane requires relay fallback enabled and preflight PASS.

maya: acceptance tests: 3 pilot installs with zero manual netops changes, plus one simulated driver mismatch where rollback must finish within MTTR.

chris: air-gap note: some customers will be offline. for those: preflight runs offline checks, manifest is produced but HMAC verification happens out-of-band. relay not available. upgrade lane must be cautious-only.

devon: add-on: operator checklist PDF from console (one-page) with PASS/WARN/FAIL, single-line remediation, and consent checkbox for telemetry. legal wants phrasing stored with timestamp.

legal: suggested opt-in text: "I consent to share an anonymized install manifest with Redwood for support and troubleshooting." record checkbox + UTC time in manifest.

frank: rollback triggers: auto-halt and rollback on >3% node failures OR control-plane error spike >5% sustained over 5m. include a forced manual rollback path too.

maya: console UX: schedule card, lane selector (fast/cautious), preflight report download, and maintenance calendar export (ics).

chris: ownership & timeline: devon => preflight + offline handling PoC in 5 business days; maya => console card + schedule API in 2w; frank => upgrade-lane automation + rollback tests in lab in 3w; legal => consent + sample contract clause by EOW.

onramp-bot: TASK created ONRAMP-7002 assigned: devon (preflight PoC).

chris: acceptance criteria before customer sign-off:
- maintenance window API + console scheduling implemented
- preflight tool + manifest schema published and validated by pilot
- upgrade lanes documented + rollback tests pass in lab
- operator one-page PDF available with consent and HMAC proof for installer

maya: if we hit these milestones we'll ask the customer to sign within their requested SLA window. will follow up next Tue. :thumbsup:
